title: Special Topics in National/International Cinemas; Migration Cinema
description: Focuses on how cinematic explorations about lived experiences of migrants have illuminated human experiences shaped by domestic and international crossings and the complexities of labor, family migration, and diasporic worlds. At the same time, cinema about migrancy and migration has offered critical perspectives about colonialism, war, and exile, post-Cold War political constellations and post-9/11 borders, hyphenated identities, and neoliberalism.
